envelope.description: Migrate legacy secrets on first use

body.title: Migrate legacy secrets on first use
body.summary: For a name absent from the vault, not retired and with no reusable run result, read the legacy item single-flight per name and copy a found value through the mutation queue after re-checking the current state, with per-name run states for a cached value, an absence and a refused read.
acceptanceChecks: A legacy secret is copied once and read from the vault afterwards
Concurrent misses of one name share one legacy read and one copy
A save or delete during a legacy read wins and the copy is discarded
A failed copy serves later reads from memory, keeps the legacy item and reads it again on the next run
An absent name causes no write and no second lookup in the run
A refused legacy read fails at once for five minutes for that name only and then retries
A retired name does not read its legacy item
